**Description**

```
The Trưng sisters led a revolt against Han China in 40–43 CE. The earliest records are Chinese; the main Vietnamese chronicle dates from 1479.
Sources: Hou Hanshu (Book of the Later Han); Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư (1479); K. W. Taylor, The Birth of Vietnam (1983) and A History of the Vietnamese (2013); Britannica.
Where sources disagree (motive, manner of death) we show both. Illustrations and narration are AI-assisted. Corrections welcome in the comments.
```
